mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, it is 56 degrees and overcast near Verona Area High School. We have a waxing crescent moon, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 47 degrees with no rain expected.

The Verona Police Department recently arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired, and the city is reminding residents to check their polling locations for upcoming elections. Additionally, the city is in the process of updating zoning ordinances.

There is plenty to do today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market on October 17.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Officers confirmed the driver was operating while impaired, though alcohol was not a factor.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM this evening.
